title: Add the bounded bootstrap prefix caller and refusal controls
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Preserve the independently accepted conditional bounded caller and register its exact 11-method NEW-only fixture as a self-contained research export at `research/h25-v03-bounded-prefix-caller`. The 34,716-byte caller has SHA256 `25138c2c998762649c6a61cb8a6ae8aacd81bd533591b082ab6f58def712fca2`; the 14,236-byte fixture has SHA256 `310fe5a31db4c4ac2bab0794a1633ec2061e8f97de654f9701b019185b138765`.

The caller replaces only its old 9,574-byte support prefix with the accepted 9,878-byte prefix (`48bc4009…`), closing the copied-prefix short-I/O-cap gap. Every following byte equals the old90a tail. Exact original `source_packet` and `RootProxy` segments remain preserved. The old caller is inert comparison/gap evidence. The bounded caller received conditional source-component acceptance; its exact independent review `f61464ed7496af2ae47414bcdfad2f63e773563411c4e70a2fc8955442e7b089` is retained. The new preparer is a separate source export.

This is source preservation and finite replay, with a parameterized operation bill. It grants no admission for complete compiler-input closure, bootstrap controls, runtime, current T0, source/native identities, C07, funding, resource fit or enclosing-parent exit, complete physical invoice, new κ, human review or proof-kernel acceptance. Recorded guarded 94.550533479/2400 is not the physical total; outside costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. The app goal remains separately paused.

Explicit incremental source-publication assignment, metadata base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, task `portable-replay`, **changed scope** recorded in TASK.json. No fresh task draw or research expansion. Current base/card/rules are exactly provenance-pinned; all replay sources and data are package-local exact exports authenticated by SOURCE-ORIGINS and MANIFEST. No dependency on an unpublished predecessor checkout, hidden import, live original tree or full original Git history is claimed.

Nearest overlap: [PR6371](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6371), entry export at head `8e772eadcbdee11289eb2eac887ffc15b864587c`, and [PR6370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6370), inputs export at head `e144f3b0a440fd33efdcfa4e0bd1af059dfd4fb3`. Parent-verified PR6371 hosted run 41461567788 attempt 1 had actual plan/replay/unchanged-inputs SUCCESS. Historical predecessor [PR6368](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6368) head `3a2d75adec6133a5bc3e6c4a082369101e6c1158` and [PR6369](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6369) head `190e63e0ca5b16e45d8202bec7dc7426dc76c5dd` retain their own scope. These prior-head checks supply no hosted check for this new caller PR. The offline export worker performed no network/overlap refresh or submission; the parent owns live submission checks.

Added value is the separate accepted bounded caller and unchanged 11-method controls, exact three passive fixture dependencies, preservation/basis/support snapshots, static resource bill, raw author normal/O logs and source-review boundary. This is not a copy of the entry package for provenance.

## Validation

Observed locally on Python 3.12:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-v03-bounded-prefix-caller --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-v03-bounded-prefix-caller
```

Metadata/pins PASS. Registered normal and optimized profiles each passed exactly 11 frozen methods (0.680 s/0.713 s unittest times). Final-manifest package-only cold copies passed the same 11 normal/O methods (0.696 s/0.679 s). The final manifest is SHA256 `a861fbca45719e0e561ba8466d4b9db993a296457de7d965e13beb7fd41e02c6` and covers41 files plus itself. All 42 files were explicitly byte/mode/coldcopy/Git-filter audited; all 32 origin rows match actual sources. These checks cover untracked bytes directly and do not rely on unstaged `git diff`.

The fixture compiles only the exact NEW support prefix, six named NEW helpers and NEW dispatch subclass with a fake base/recheck. Positive short-read completion and refusal-before the 8,193rd/4,097th calls, raw primary/cleanup custody, inventory/mode/symlink/nested-manifest controls, prior-digest failure, five-false-field DATA cases, exact new basename and fake dispatch ordering remain unchanged. The three passive dependencies are the old caller, accepted entry and actual original supervisor snapshot. The supervisor is inert hash-checked DATA. Full caller main, original source_packet/RootProxy, original modules/archived tests, compiler/native/subreaper/domain/namespace/Popen/Root/target operations were not executed.

All outputs were outside the packet. Frozen EOF-blankline warnings in the two review Markdown copies are retained. Two external audit-driver attempts initially mishandled `git diff --no-index --check` status bits1/3; both failures are preserved in the local export receipt. Corrected bookkeeping explicitly records difference/whitespace bits and did not change source/packet bytes or rerun successful methods. A known unrelated missing cache blob `f0d42d430159f3f46dcf447ecb5df8aa9355e208` (`artifacts/batched-23-note.pdf`) remains unrecovered; the exact base/card/rules objects and packet checks succeed. Full Git-history availability is not asserted.

The exact reviewed packet is committed with tree `d59baded9a4136d6f6dfdfd6cff41e3faec31528` and single base parent `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Committed-byte/source-history/executable-mode preflight passed for all 42 files; the source-history check covers declared base/card/rules only. The remote publication commit is `b91c5c74f252c1a98ab8344d012702170004ed13` with the identical tree; its commit timestamp differs from the retained local commit. Hosted checks for this new head are pending and will be read back before delivery is called complete. No source replay was repeated for committing.
